name: Nami
source:
[url=/c135840]Kouhei[/url]'s girlfriend.

[spoiler]She is the twin sister of [url=/c135899]Naomi[/url], adopted into a different family following some tragedy. In most routes, she is the antagonists' target.

In the Mother & Father Ending, she is possessed by her [url=/c135968]mother[/url]'s spirit and temporarily turned into a mummy.
In the Shadows Ending, her "shadow" is revealed as the source of the supernatural attacks in the mansion, using Nami's psychic powers.
In the Monster Bloodlines Ending, she is revealed as a vampire, unconsciously luring Kouhei into her [url=/c137267]father[/url]'s trap.
In the Epilogues, its revealed all of the routes were tests set up by her family to prove Kouhei's feelings for her.[/spoiler]
